candidate_grammar.boundary: Every supplied positive finite PROB-009 support, path, weight, record, decision rule and successor boundary.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete eight-axis PROB-009 product before observation access.
candidate_grammar.unique_survivor: PROB-009 uniquely retains likelihood-preserving-sufficient-record, complete deterministic support custody, root forcing, post-registry observation and no extra rule.

excluded_inputs: no axiom, fitted parameter, imported stochastic law or target outcome selects the result
probability is exact generated-support correspondence and never an ontic randomness premise
host 0 denotes structural absence or counts artifacts only and is not an SFT number object
no negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof scalar
no asymptotic distribution or completed infinite trial sequence is admitted without a separate successor certificate
no failed route retires an obligation or changes protected authority
statement: A record is sufficient when every generated observation sharing it has the same exact parameter-dependent likelihood factor and no discarded distinction changes inference.
title: Estimation and sufficient-record structure
